title: Candidate Suite Market-Leader SWOT Benchmark, Missing Feature Gap Analysis & Golden 10/10 Viewport-Dense Native Refactor Architecture
spec: MANDATE: User requires an unconditional 10/10 master refactor for every page of the Candidate Suite (and all sub-pages within) with maximum user experience, intuitive candidate journey, and minimum scroll (viewport-efficient density). Developer must execute: PHASE 1 - MARKET-LEADER SWOT BENCHMARK: Benchmark every Candidate Suite surface against premier industry leaders: 1) Resumes vs Novoresume/Enhancv, 2) Cover Letters vs Teal/Rezi, 3) Portfolios vs Bento.me/ReadCV, 4) Favorites vs LinkedIn/Otta, 5) Notifications vs GitHub/Slack, 6) Job Portal vs Wellfound/Indeed, 7) Job Tracker vs Huntr/Teal, 8) Submitted Applications vs LinkedIn Applications Hub, 9) AI Interview Coach vs Google Interview Warmup/Final Round AI, 10) Messages vs Linear/Slack, 11) Plans vs Stripe/Linear, 12) Master Profile & Security vs GitHub/LinkedIn Settings, 13) Help Desk vs Intercom/Zendesk. PHASE 2 - MISSING FEATURE GAP IDENTIFICATION: Identify every missing capability, UX friction point, and dead end across the candidate journey. PHASE 3 - VIEWPORT-EFFICIENT 'MINIMUM SCROLL' ARCHITECTURE: Redesign each page layout to fit standard viewports with minimum vertical scroll using split-views, sticky rails, compact HUDs, and 100% Cuba M3 glassmorphism in both light and dark modes. PHASE 4 - PROVEN 10/10 PLAN: Formulate an exhaustive, multi-step plan via 'bridge dev plan --directive DIR-082'. Only proceed to implementation when the plan is proven and approved by Lead.

plan.summary: DIR-082 PHASES 1-3 delivered as forensic analysis; PHASE 4 is this plan. PHASE 1 BENCHMARK + PHASE 3 DENSITY FORENSICS are MEASURED, not asserted: across the 14 candidate page files I counted container caps, sticky regions, grid usage, dark: variants, viewport-height units and scroll containers. RESULT: only 2 of 14 pages use ANY sticky region (Interview Coach 2, Master Profile 2); only 2 manage viewport height (Interview Coach 12 vh units, Messages 2); only Messages has a split view (delivered by DIR-081); dark: variants are effectively absent (Overview 11, Portfolios 1, every other page 0) because the bodies are hardcoded legacy utilities instead of Cuba tokens; container caps are inconsistent (Jobs 2, Interview Coach/Master Profile/Plans/Support/Job Tracker 1 each, the other 8 inherit the shell cap max-w-[1680px]). The minimum-scroll premise is therefore CORRECT and now quantified: the suite is a set of single-column vertically-scrolling documents with no sticky rails, no bounded scroll regions and no split views. PER-SURFACE BENCHMARK vs the named leaders: 1 Resumes (ResumesList.jsx 208 lines, 0 ATS/keyword scoring, 0 template gallery, 0 search) vs Novoresume/Enhancv which lead with an ATS readiness score, a template gallery and inline content suggestions - we have none of those. 2 Cover Letters (CoversList.jsx 148 lines, no preview pane, no tone or length controls) vs Teal/Rezi which pair the list with a live preview plus generation controls. 3 Portfolios (search, filter, 15 template refs, grid+list) vs Bento.me/ReadCV which add a detail drawer and per-item analytics - we have no analytics. 4 Favorites (10 filter refs, CubaEmptyState) vs LinkedIn/Otta which add collections and folders - we have none. 5 Notifications (CubaEmptyState, 15 primitives) vs GitHub/Slack which add a filter rail (unread/type/date) and grouped timelines - ours is a flat list. 6 Job Portal (0 sticky) vs Wellfound/Indeed which lead with a sticky filter rail, saved searches and alerts - we have neither the rail nor alerts. 7 Job Tracker (Kanban from DIR-020, 9 grids, 18 breakpoints, 0 legacy) vs Huntr/Teal which add reminders and a pipeline HUD - we have no reminder timeline. 8 Submitted Applications (5 grids, 0 legacy) vs the LinkedIn Applications Hub which shows a status timeline - ours is a stat row plus cards. 9 AI Interview Coach (DashboardInterviews.jsx 2,927 lines, 1 cuba vs 764 legacy colour, 12 vh units, 22 grids) vs Google Interview Warmup and Final Round AI which pair a question rail with an answer canvas and a scoring HUD - ours has live sessions but no bounded split view and is the worst-styled surface in the suite. 10 Messages (lg split view from DIR-081) vs Linear/Slack which add a third details pane at xl plus a composer toolbar - ours stops at two panes. 11 Plans (PlansTable, 301 cuba, 0 legacy) vs Stripe/Linear which add a comparison matrix and a usage HUD - ours has a table but no usage telemetry. 12 Master Profile and Security (DashboardSettings.jsx 5,873 lines, 0 cuba vs 1,330 legacy colour, 12 profile sub-tabs, a TOTP hub, AND a legacy DashboardSettings.scss) vs GitHub/LinkedIn Settings which use a sticky left settings rail - ours is one long scrolling document. 13 Help Desk (DashboardSupport.jsx 863 lines, 28 search, 17 FAQ refs, 0 cuba) vs Intercom/Zendesk which lead with a search-first hero and a sticky category rail - ours has the content but no sticky rail and no Cuba styling. PHASE 2 MISSING FEATURE GAPS (ranked, each tied to its surface): G1 ATS and keyword readiness scoring on Resumes; G2 a template gallery plus version history on Resumes; G3 a live preview plus tone and length controls on Cover Letters; G4 per-item portfolio analytics; G5 favorites collections and folders; G6 a notification filter rail plus preferences; G7 job saved searches and alerts; G8 a tracker reminder timeline; G9 an applications status timeline; G10 an interview question bank plus answer scoring HUD; G11 a messages third details pane, composer toolbar and templates; G12 plan usage telemetry and a comparison matrix; G13 settings active sessions and devices plus data export; G14 a support search-first hero plus sticky categories; G15 a global density toggle (Comfortable/Compact), absent everywhere. FRICTION AND DEAD ENDS: no page bounds its scroll region so every action pushes the header out of view; Settings is a 5,873-line single scroll with no sticky sub-nav, so its 12 sub-tabs are reachable only by scrolling or deep link; Resumes and Cover Letters have no search and no preview so a candidate cannot see what they are about to send; there is no dark-mode parity outside Overview. PHASE 3 ARCHITECTURE: five new Cuba primitives plus a density provider, then per-page redesigns, then the two monoliths as mechanical migrations. INVARIANTS: XAMPP-only servers, no detached node/vite/nodemon daemon; frozen src/cv-templates diff 0; no auth, token, API, DB or RBAC change; zero fabricated data - every HUD must bind to a real query or be omitted, never invented; preserve every DIR-048/055/072-081 pin and the DIR-081 test suite; sub-4s build; 0 lint errors. UX STATES: every redesigned surface keeps the DIR-081 four-state contract (ready/loading/empty/error) via CubaPageFrame v2 with a persistent header and toolbar, and every split view keeps a single-column fallback below lg with a back-to-list control. RESPONSIVE: 375px single column with list/detail swap, 768px two columns, 1280px+ the dense layout with a sticky rail, 1680px+ the full three-pane where applicable. QA: a new tests/dir082-viewport-density.test.mjs that supersedes the DIR-081 ratchet with zero-legacy baselines. A11Y: one main landmark per page, aria-current on every rail item, focus-visible preserved, the density toggle is a labelled radiogroup, split-view panes are labelled regions, and contrast stays AA in BOTH themes. PERFORMANCE: no new dependencies, no timers, no simulated latency; the work is layout-only and should REDUCE paint cost because bounded scroll regions avoid full-document reflow; build stays under 4s. SEQUENCING AND RISK: primitives first, then the two monoliths as mechanical token and layout migrations rather than rewrites, then the remaining pages. ROLLBACK: every step is independently revertible; no schema, API or data surface is touched.
steps: S1 - Extend the Cuba design system with the viewport-dense primitives: CubaViewport (a scroll region bounded by h-[calc(100vh-var(--cuba-header-h))]), CubaSplitView (list plus detail with an lg breakpoint and a mobile back-to-list), CubaStickyRail (sticky top-[var(--cuba-header-h)]), CubaHud (a compact KPI strip), CubaToolbar, and a CubaDensityProvider that persists Comfortable/Compact in localStorage and exposes it through context.

S2 - Upgrade CubaPageFrame to v2 with a dense mode: the header and toolbar stay mounted and the content region becomes a bounded scroll area so the page header never scrolls out of view, while keeping the DIR-081 ready/loading/empty/error contract and the data-page-state attribute.

S3 - Complete the token sweep and dark-mode parity on the six DIR-081 backlog files (DashboardSettings 1330, DashboardInterviews 764, DashboardHomepage 226, DashboardSupport 183, DashboardPortfolios 51, ResumesList 12), replacing DashboardSettings.scss with Cuba tokens and adding dark: variants only where a raw utility must remain.
S4 - Overview (DashboardHomepage.jsx): a sticky executive rail, a compact HUD strip, a Next-best-action card and a viewport-bounded main column.

S5 - Resumes (ResumesList.jsx) vs Novoresume/Enhancv: a split view with a sticky list and a live preview, an ATS and keyword readiness HUD bound to the real resume payload, a search and filter toolbar, a template gallery entry, and the missing responsive breakpoints.
S6 - Cover Letters (CoversList.jsx) vs Teal/Rezi: a split view using the already-imported cv-templates/cover1/Cover1 live preview, tone and length controls and a compact HUD.
S7 - Portfolios (DashboardPortfolios.jsx) vs Bento.me/ReadCV: a detail drawer, a per-item analytics HUD using real view counts only, a template strip, and the remaining 51 legacy utilities.

S8 - Favorites (vs LinkedIn/Otta) and Notifications (vs GitHub/Slack): collections and folders with a sticky filter rail on Favorites, and a filter rail (unread/type/date), a grouped timeline and mark-all-read on Notifications.

S9 - Jobs, Job Tracker and Submitted Applications: a sticky filter rail plus saved searches and alerts on Jobs, a viewport-bounded Kanban with a sticky stage header and a pipeline HUD on Job Tracker, and a status timeline plus a sticky stat strip on Applied.

S10 - Interview Coach, Messages and Plans: a question rail plus an answer canvas with a scoring HUD on the Coach, a third details pane at xl plus a composer toolbar on Messages, and a comparison matrix plus a usage HUD on Plans.

S11 - Master Profile and Security (DashboardSettings.jsx) plus Support (DashboardSupport.jsx): a sticky left settings rail driving the 12 sub-tabs with a viewport-bounded content pane (replacing DashboardSettings.scss), and a search-first hero plus a sticky category rail on Support.

S12 - Author tests/dir082-viewport-density.test.mjs (AC1 the five primitives exist and are exported, AC2 every candidate page renders a bounded scroll region, AC3 zero legacy utilities and dark-mode parity across all 15 pages superseding the DIR-081 ratchet, AC4 a11y landmarks and aria-current and focus, AC5 no new dependencies and build under 4s, AC6 no fabricated telemetry) and register test:dir082.

S13 - Run dir082, dir081, dir080..dir072, cuba-candidate-portal, cuba-design-system, the dir048 suites, test:product, test:security:static, test:xampp-policy, dir063..dir082, build (under 4s), lint (0 errors), confirm frozen cv-templates diff 0, write .bridge/evidence/dir082-evidence.log and submit.
